mapper.select: SELECT id, BandName, licenseNumber, TypeCode, currentLatitude, currentLongitude, CurrentAction, isDeleted FROM vehicle ORDER BY id
SELECT id, BandName, licenseNumber, TypeCode, currentLatitude, currentLongitude, CurrentAction, isDeleted FROM vehicle WHERE isDeleted = 0 OR isDeleted IS NULL ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle (BandName, licenseNumber, TypeCode, currentLatitude, currentLongitude, CurrentAction, isDeleted) VALUES (#{bandName}, #{licenseNumber}, #{typeCode}, #{currentLatitude}, #{currentLongitude}, #{currentAction}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE vehicle SET bandName = #{bandName}, licenseNumber = #{licenseNumber}, typeCode = #{typeCode}, currentLatitude = #{currentLatitude}, currentLongitude = #{currentLongitude}, currentAction = #{currentAction} WHERE id = #{id}
